calculation.description: During broad cross-asset stress, rank assets that have underperformed their cross-sectional 3-day median as rebound candidates; suppress the signal outside stressed breadth regimes. All inputs are lagged through the observation date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (+0.0162602; 63 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.0437040; 33 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.0524626; 38 dates). Small cross-section uncertainty remains material; only 134 stressed daily IC observations qualified.
validation.audit_note: Library correlation is signal-artifact Pearson correlation against available prior artifacts and is provenance only; deterministic post-Miner audit remains authoritative.
